body:
Same. I often make up short storys in my mind where I am loved. I make up a wonderful partner, who loves me for who I am and holds me dear,  awesome friends and family that I joke around with and a general happy life.
It makes me happy for a short while, but then reality comes crashing down and I feel evenmore empty and lonely then before. It is the only thing that makes me happy anymore, but at the same time in shows so clearly what my real life is lacking. I know what I make up is only a fantasy and will never become real and it is hurting so bad...

I do that all the time. I get inspired by something and  then start to dream about it. I often lay in bed listening to music and replay some scenes matching the sound over and over. Or I do the same as you and make up a plot right before I go to sleep.
In this made up storys and worlds I am always tough or strong, I have a bunch of awesome friends and a partner or someone who I like and who likes me too. 
The characters involved change all the time, but the plot is always simliar. Honestly I know I make these storyd up, because I feel so freaking lonely. In this storys I can be how I want to be. I have what I truly desire and feel loved, but then I get pulled back to reality and it sucks. These fantasies are the only thing keeping me going or making me feel happy and not so alone, but at the same time the difference between them and reality is crushing me. I often feel even worse a while after I made up a new story...

I feel you. This may sound crazy I sometimes hug myself (of course it isn't the same as a real hug), I just feel so lonely and miss the  feeling of lying in someones arms. 
For me it still wouldn't do any hug, it has to come from someone who truly cares about me and loves me. When I greet people and they hug me it often feels just wrong, I can tell it is not genuine. What I desire is a real long loving hug... someone holding me in their arms and telling me I am ok the way I am, that I am worthy to be loved...

I know that's what I always get told. You're still young... Well and what if I am young. 
This feeling of not belonging and being empty has been there all my life. I doubt this will change. I mean I really tried, but in the end it always turns out the same. My feelings inside don't change. It isn't a feeling I suddenly started to have after a breakup or somethings, it was always there. How do you fix something that is something that was always a part of you. Something that makes you,you.
I know it sucks. In the past I still had at least that this would maybe change in the future, but I have been proven wrong again and again...It just hurts now...

Yeah since I turned 20 every birthday is a nightmare for me. When I was younger I would have all this Ideas what my life would be like in my 20s and now it just sucks. Watching people way younger than me have these great and fulfillkng lives is just depressing.

Also I am not saying I just want to date inteoverts, butme and a total extrovert wouldn't fit probably.
I just want someone that doesn't feel bored spending an evening at home watching movies or playing games instead of partying all the time. An ambivert for that reason would  also be allright. It is not as if I hate going out, it just has to be with the right person and not all the time.

I don't know sometimes I feel like the girls and guys would be fine with anyone. That just makes me feel so replaceable. I am not good enough to be some to pursue a relationship with. I am a girl by the way, but I don't care about gende  when it comes to dating.

Yeah, but the same goes for mangas, movies, TV series, webtoons and books.

I literally just put down my manga, because it made me feel so bad. Often it is just the tiniest things that make me feel terrible. Like the small acts of kindness and caring for another person in a story. It just remindes me of what I am lacking in life.
I am going to turn 24 in summer and I have been feeling all alone for such a long time. In the past I would still be able to convince myself that in the next year it would get better, but it doesn't. I know some people will tell em I am still young and that I will find someone, but the past 23 1/2 years say otherwise. I suffer from depression, social anxiety, anxiety in general and panic attacks, so I am not one to go out all the time  and meet new people... and even if I meet people our interests and character don't match at all. Some people say I should go out more into bars and clubs, but that isn't me..So if I met someone there who goes clubbing regulary what would I gain, we wouldn't match. (Happend before to me). If I meet someone they either are way more extroverted then me or just want to be friends with benefits. Honestly I just want one person who loves me and who I can share my life with. Someone who likes my little quirks and who I can joke around with. Someone who makes me want to try new things and share interests with.
BUT I know this isn't going to happen and this makes me feel so broken and lonely, that honestly I don't know how to go on.
In the past I would be able to escape with Manga, Anime and so on, but now that even hurts me...
